summary: Slide Insurance Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the completion of its 2026-2027 catastrophe reinsurance program. The program increased total aggregate limit to $5.463 billion (from $3.304 billion) and first-event coverage to $3.981 billion. Retention is capped at 25% of estimated pre-tax earnings ($166.8m first-event, $150m second-event). Twelve new markets were added and the Purple Re catastrophe bond limit rose to $780m. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation like an M&A, restructuring, or shareholder activism.
